data.titulo: Babg 2—Sa-​kãsengã niib n tãag Ezipt yiibu
data.contenido:
Yaa neb a nii bal n põs sa-​kãsengã. La tarẽ-n-​tarẽ, nebã wa n lebga wʋsgo. Yaa yʋʋm kobs-​tã la pis-⁠nu la a yiib sa-​kãsengã loogr poor la a Abrahaam rog-​yã. Wẽnnaam pʋlm-⁠a lame t’a na n paama bi-​ribl sẽn boond t’a Izaake. D na n yãa Wẽnnaam sẽn sɩd pids a pʋlengã to-⁠to. A Izaak paama kamb a yiibu, a Ezayu ne a Zakoobe. Wẽnnaam da nonga a Zakoobe.

A Zakoob paama kom-​dibli 12, la kom-​pugli me. Kom-​dibli wã sʋka, bãmb piig n da pa nong b yao a Zozɛfe, tɩ kɩt tɩ b koos-⁠a t’a tɩ lebg yamb Ezipti. Kaoosg zugẽ, a Zozɛf lebga nin-​kãseng Ezipti. Kom n wa n zĩndi, t’a Zozɛf na n mak a kẽem dãmbã n ges b sã n toeema zʋgo. Tarẽ-n-​tarẽ, b wa n boonda a Zakoob zakã neb tɩ Israɛll neba. La yʋʋm kobs-⁠yi la pis-⁠wɛ a Abrahaam rogmã poore, b fãa yik n kẽnga Ezipti.

Israɛll nebã vɩɩmda Ezipt yʋʋm kobs-⁠yi la piig la a nu. A Zozɛf kũumã poore, b lebga yembse. Sẽn wa n beẽ-n-​beẽ, biig n dog tɩ b pʋd a yʋʋr t’a Moiizi. Yaa yẽ la Wẽnnaam wa n tʋm t’a tɩ yiis Israɛll nebã Ezipti. Kibay nins fãa sẽn be babg a yiib soabã pʋgẽ wã zĩnda yʋʋm kobs-​nii la pis-⁠nu la a yopoe pʋgẽ.

A NOWE ne a zaka rãmb yii koglgã pʋgẽ masã. Yãmb mii a Nowe sẽn maan bũmb ning pipi bɩ? A kõo Wẽnnaam kũuni. A kõo Wẽnnaam rũms n na n pʋʋs-⁠a barka, a sẽn kɩt tɩ yẽ ne a zaka rãmb põsã yĩnga. Yaa rẽ la y sẽn ne fotã zugã.

La a Zeova sũur yɩɩ noog bɩ? N-⁠ye. A pʋlma a Nowe t’a ka na n le sãam nebã ne sa-​kãseng ye.



Rẽ poor bilfu, tẽngã kʋɩɩme t’a Nowe ne a zaka rãmb tõe n le vɩɩmd a zugu, tɩ nin-​wẽns ka le beẽ ye. Wẽnnaam ninga a Nowe ne a zaka rãmb barka, la a yeel-⁠b woto: ‘Rog-⁠y kamb wʋsgo, tɩ nebã lebg wʋsg tẽngã gill zugu.’

La tõe tɩ nebã sã n wa bãng tɩ sa-​kãseng n da ni, b na n yɛɛsame n tẽed tɩ woto buud na n le wa zĩndi. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ Wẽnnaam maan bũmb sẽn na yɩl tɩ nebã tẽeg t’a pa na n le kɩt tɩ sa-​kãseng ni n sãam nebã ye. Yãmb mii a sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ? A kɩtame tɩ saag gomtɩʋʋg puki.

Saag sã n ni n yoog tɩ wĩntoogã yi, saag gomtɩʋʋgã nong n pukdame. Saag gomtɩʋʋg tara kulɛɛr toor-​toore, tɩ yaa neere. Yãmb zoe n yãa saag gomtɩʋʋg bɩ? Yaa rẽ la sẽn be fotã zugã.

Wẽnnaam yeela a Nowe woto: ‘Mam pa na n le sãam nebã fãa la rũmsã ne sa-​kãseng ye. Mam na n ninga m saag gomtɩʋʋg sawatẽ wã. Saag gomtɩʋʋgã sã n puki, mam na n tẽegã kãabg ning m sẽn maanã.’Yãmb sã n yã saag gomtɩʋʋgo, segd n tẽega yãmb bõe? A segd n tẽega yãmb tɩ Wẽnnaam kãabame t’a pa na n le sãam nebã ne koom ye. Sɩngre 8:⁠18-⁠22; 9:​9-⁠17. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A NOWE kom-​dibli wã roga kamb wʋsgo. Kom-​kãens me lebga bɛd n dog kamba. Tarẽ-n-​tarẽ, neba lebga wʋsg tẽngã zugu.

A Nowe yageng a ye n da boond t’a Nimrood. A ra yaa tãoos sẽn yaa nin-​wẽnga, n kʋʋd rũms la neba. A maana a meng rĩm n na n soog nebã. La Wẽnnaam da pa nong a Nimrood ye. Wakat kãnga, neba fãa ra gomda gom-​yende. A Nimrood da ratame tɩ nebã fãa pa zĩ-yend tɩ yẽ paam n soog-⁠ba. Yãmb mii a sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ? A yeela nebã tɩ b wa tɩ b naag taab n zĩnd tẽng a yembre, la b me gasg a pʋgẽ. Yãmb pa ne nebã sẽn wẽed tãn-​koɛɛm fotã zug sɩda?

La Wẽnnaam a Zeova ra pa rat woto ye. A ra ratame tɩ nebã sãeeg n pid tẽngã. La nebã yeelame yaa: ‘Wa-⁠y tɩ d me tẽnga, la gãsg t’a woglem ta saasẽ, n bao yʋʋre.’ B ra ratame n bao yʋʋre, b pa rat n waoog Wẽnnaam ye.

La Wẽnnaam kɩtame tɩ b ka me gasgã n baas ye. Yãmb mii a sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ? A kɩtame tɩ b goamã lebg toɛy-​toɛya. B tiig n gomda goam toɛy-​toɛy masã, n pa le wʋmd taab goam ye. Rẽ n so tɩ b boond b tẽngã tɩ Babɛll bɩ Babilon, sẽn dat n yeel tɩ “kalem-​kalem.”

Nebã yii Babɛll n sãeeg n kẽng zĩis toor-​toore. Neb nins sẽn da wʋmd taab goamã tũu taab n tɩ vɩɩmd zĩ-yende.Sɩngre 10:​1, 8-⁠10; 11:​1-⁠9. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

SA-​KÃSENGÃ poore, neb n da tɩ vɩ Uur tẽngã pʋgẽ. Uur lebga tẽn-​bedre, n tar ro-​neeba, la a nebã ra pʋʋsda ziri wẽnnaam dãmba, wa Babɛll nebã me sẽn da pʋʋsd ziri wẽnnaam dãmbã. Uur la Babɛll nebã ra pa tũud a Zeova ye. La a Nowe ne a bi-​ribl a Sɛm yẽ ra tũuda a Zeova.

A Nowe kell n saka Wẽnnaam wakat fãa. La yʋʋm kobs-​tã la pis-⁠nu sa-​kãsengã niib poore, a kiime. Yaa a kũumã yʋʋm a yiib poor la rao ning sẽn be fotã zugã rog-​yã. Wẽnnaam da nonga ra-​kãngã wʋsgo. A yʋʋr la a Abrahaam. Yẽ ne a zaka rãmb ra vɩɩ Uur tẽngã pʋgẽ.

Raar a yembre, a Zeova yeela a Abrahaam woto: ‘Yik n bas f tẽnga ne f buudã la f zakã n kẽng tẽng ninga mam sẽn na n wilg foo wã.’ A Abrahaam kelga Wẽnnaam n sak n loog n bas a te-​neebã la a ro-​neerã bɩ? N-⁠ye, a sakame. Yaa a Abrahaam sẽn da sakd Wẽnnaam wakat fãa wã yĩng la Wẽnnaam sẽn da boond-⁠a t’a zoa wã.

A Abrahaam zaka neb kẽer tũ-a lame n yi Uur. Yaa a ba a Teera, a Lot sẽn da yaa a kẽem biigã, la a pag a Saara. B kẽname n wa ta zĩig b sẽn boond tɩ Harã. Harã ra zãra ne Uur wʋsgo. A Teera kii be.

Wakat a wãn poore, a Abrahaam ne a zaka rãmb yii Harã n kẽng Kanaã. B sẽn ta be wã, a Zeova yeela a Abrahaam woto: ‘Yaa tẽn-​kãngã la mam na n kõ fo yagensã.’ A Abrahaam tilga fu-​rot Kanaã n vɩɩmd be.

Wẽnnaam sõnga a Abrahaam t’a paam piis la rũms a taab wʋsgo, la a paam tʋm-​tʋmdb wʋsg me. La yẽ ne a pag a Saara ra pa tar biig ye.

A Abrahaam sẽn wa n tar yʋʋm 99, a Zeova yeel-⁠a-⁠la woto: ‘Ad kãabg mam sẽn kãabd foom. Fo na n lebga buud wʋsg ba.’ La a Abrahaam ne a Saara yaool n da kʋʋla wʋsgo. B ra na n maana wãn n paam biiga?ad Sɩngre 11:⁠27-⁠32; 12:​1-⁠7; 17:​1-⁠8, 15-⁠17; 18:​9-⁠19. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB nee a Abrahaam sẽn dat n maan bũmb ningã bɩ? A zãada sʋʋga, la wõnda a rat n kʋʋ a bi-​riblã. Bõe yĩng t’a rat n maan woto? D reng n ges sẽn yɩ to-⁠to t’a Abrahaam ne a Saara wa paam b biigã.

Tẽeg-⁠y tɩ Wẽnnaam da kãabame tɩ b na n paama biiga. La a Abrahaam ne a Saara sẽn da kʋʋl wʋsgã yĩnga, wõnda b ra pa tõe n paam biig ye. La a Abrahaam ra tẽedame tɩ Wẽnnaam tõe n kɩtame tɩ b paam biiga. D ges sẽn yɩ to-⁠to.

Wẽnnaam sẽn yeel tɩ b na n paama biigã poore, maana yʋʋmde. A Abrahaam sẽn wa n tar yʋʋm 100 t’a Saara tar yʋʋm 90 wã, b roga bi-​ribl n pʋd-⁠a t’a Izaak. Wẽnnaam sɩd maana wa a sẽn da yeelã bal kɛpɩ!

La a Izaak sẽn wa n bɩ n lebg bedre, a Zeova kosa a Abrahaam bũmb n na n ges a sã n sɩd tẽeda yẽ. A boola a Abrahaam, t’a Abrahaam sake. T’a yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Rɩk a Izaak sẽn yaa fo bi-​yendã, n kẽng tãng ning mam sẽn na n wilg foomã zug n tɩ maan maoongo.’

A Abrahaam sẽn wʋm woto wã, a sũurã sãamame. A ra nonga a bi-​riblã hal wʋsgo. Tẽeg-⁠y me tɩ Wẽnnaam da yeelame t’a Abrahaam kamb ne a yagens n na n vɩɩmd Kanaã. La a Izaak sã n ki, rẽ pa le tõe ye. A Abrahaam da pa wʋmd Wẽnnaam goamã võor ye, la a maana a sẽn yeelã bala.

A Abrahaam sẽn ta tãngã zugã, a mee tẽn-​kugri. Rẽ poore, a sẽba a Izaak n dogl tẽn-​kugrã zugu, n dɩk sʋʋgã n na n kodg-⁠a. La Wẽnnaam malɛk a ye yeelame: ‘Abrahaam, Abrahaam!’ T’a Abrahaam sak tɩ: ‘Naaba!’

Tɩ malɛkã yeel-⁠a tɩ Wẽnnaam yeelame yaa: ‘Ra maan biigã bũmb ye. Masã, mam bãngame tɩ fo tẽeda maam, bala fo ka mong maam fo biigã sẽn yaa fo bi-​yendã ye.’

Ad a Abrahaam sɩd ra tẽeda Wẽnnaam ne a sũur fãa koe! A ra kɩsa sɩd t’a Zeova tõee bũmb fãa, la t’a tõeeme meng n vʋʋg a Izaake. La Wẽnnaam da pa rat t’a Abrahaam sɩd kʋ a Izaak ye. A kɩtame tɩ pesg yɩɩl gaag ne tuugu, t’a yeel a Abrahaam t’a yõk pesgã n maan maoong la a bas a biigã.Sɩngre 21:​1-⁠7; 22:​1-⁠18. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A LOT ne a zaka rãmb ra vɩɩ ne a Abrahaam Kanaã. Raar a yembre, a Abrahaam yeela a Lot yaa: ‘Tẽngã yamdã pa le sekd tõnd d yiiba fãa rũmsã ye. Bɩ d welg taaba. Fo sã n kẽng rɩtgo, mam na n kẽnga goabga. La fo sã n kẽng goabga, mam na n kẽnga rɩtgo.’

A Lot zẽka a neng n ges tẽngã, n yã tɩ Zʋrdẽ babgã yaa zĩ-neer sẽn tar koom la yamd sõma sẽn sekd a rũmsã. A yika ne a zaka rãmb la a rũmsã n kẽng be. B tɩ zĩnda Sodom tẽngã pʋgẽ.

Sodom nebã ra yaa wẽns wʋsgo. Woto ra sãamda a Lot sũurã wʋsgo, bala a ra yaa nin-​sõngo. Wẽnnaam me sũur da puuda ne-⁠ba. Wẽnnaam wa n tʋma malɛgs a yiib tɩ b tɩ yeel a Lot t’a na n sãama Sodom la a sãam Gomoor sẽn yaa tẽng sẽn pẽ be wã me, bala b nebã yaa nin-​wẽnse.

Malɛgsã yeela a Lot yaa: ‘Yik tao-​tao n peeg f paga ne f kom-​pugli a yiibã n zoe n yi tẽngã.’ La malɛgsã mikame t’a Lot ne a zaka rãmb maasame, tɩ b gãd b nusã n tall-⁠b n yiis tẽngã kɩrenga. Beenẽ, malɛk a ye n yeel-⁠b woto: ‘Zoe-⁠y n põs-⁠y-​yã. Ra wẽneg-⁠y n ges y poorẽ ye. Zoe-⁠y n kẽng-⁠y tãensẽ wã, n da wa ki ye.’ A Lot ne a kom-​pugli wã kelga malɛkã goamã n zoe n yi Sodom. B pa yaas zĩig baa a yembre, b pa wẽneg n ges b poorẽ me ye. La a Lot pagã yẽ kɩɩsame. B sẽn wa n yi Sodom tẽngã n zãag bilfã, a yalsame n wẽneg n ges a poorẽ, t’a mengã fãa lebg yamsem. Yãmb pa ne-⁠a fotã zug sɩda?

Tõnd tõe n dɩka yam ne kiba-​kãngã. A wilgda tõnd tɩ Wẽnnaam fãagda neb nins sẽn kelgd a goamã. La a na n sãama neb nins fãa sẽn kɩɩsd yẽ wã.Sɩngre 13:​5-⁠13; 18:⁠20-⁠33; 19:​1-⁠29; Luk 17:⁠28-⁠32; 2 Pɩɛɛr 2:​6-⁠8. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii pag ning sẽn be fotã zugã bɩ? A yʋʋr la a Rebeka. Rao ning sẽn kẽnd n segd-⁠a wã yaa a Izaak. A na n lebga a Izaak paga. La sɩnga wãn-​wãna?

A Abrahaam da ratame t’a biig a Izaak paam pʋg-​sõngo. A ra pa rat t’a Izaak kẽ kãadem ne Kanaã bi-​pugl ye. Bala Kanaã nebã ra pʋʋsda ziri wẽnnaam dãmba. Rẽ n so t’a Abrahaam bool a tʋm-​tʋmdã n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Mam datame tɩ fo kẽng mam buudã neb nengẽ Harã n tɩ bao pag bãmb sʋk n wa kõ m biig a Izaake.’

Tao-​tao bala, a Abrahaam tʋm-​tʋmdã baoa yʋgma piig n na n tog sorã. Harã ra zãra wʋsg ne Kanaã. A sẽn wa n kolgd zĩig ning a Abrahaam buudã neb sẽn beẽ wã, a yalsa bulg noore. Ra yaa zaabre, tẽngã pagb sẽn nong n wat n wiid koomã bulgẽ wã sasa. A Abrahaam tʋm-​tʋmdã pʋʋsa a Zeova n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Bɩ f kɩt tɩ pʋg-​sad ning sẽn na n sak n wi koom n kõ maam ne m yʋgma wã yɩ fo sẽn yãk pag ning n na n kõ a Izaakã.’

A sẽn pʋʋsã poore, pa yã n kaoos la a Rebeka wa n na n wi koom ye. A Abrahaam tʋm-​tʋmdã sẽn bõos-⁠a koomã, a kõ-a lame, la a wi wʋsg n kõ yʋgma wã me. Ra pa tʋʋmd sẽn yaa nana-​nana ye, bala yʋgma wã yũuda koom wʋsgo.

A Rebeka sẽn kõ yʋgma wã koom n sa, a Abrahaam tʋm-​tʋmdã sok-⁠a-⁠la a ba wã yʋʋre, la a sok-⁠a n ges a sã n tõe n gãanda b zakẽ wã yʋngã. A leokame t’a ba wã yʋʋr la a Betuɛlle, la tɩ zĩig bee bãmb zakẽ wã t’a tõe n gãande. A Abrahaam tʋm-​tʋmdã ra miime t’a Betuɛll yaa a Abrahaam ba-​biig a Nahoor biiga. Rẽ n so t’a yĩgimd n pʋʋs a Zeova barka, bala a Zeova sõng-⁠a lame t’a ta a Abrahaam buudã neb nengẽ.

Yʋn-​kãng menga, a Abrahaam tʋm-​tʋmdã togsa a Betuɛll la a Rebeka kẽem a Labã tɩ yẽ waame n na n bao pag n kõ a Izaake. B sakame t’a Rebeka tũ tʋm-​tʋmdã n kẽng n tɩ lebg a Izaak paga. La a Rebeka yẽ sakame bɩ? N-⁠ye, a sakame n na n tũ n kuli. Vẽkembeoogã bala, a Rebeka ne tʋm-​tʋmdã zomba yʋgma n na n kẽng Kanaã.

B sẽn ta Kanaã wã tɩ yaa zaabre. A Rebeka yãa rao sẽn kẽnd n watẽ. Ra yaa a Izaake. A sẽn yã a Rebeka wã, a sũurã yɩɩ noogo. A yamã kẽ-a lame, t’a nong-⁠a wʋsgo. A Izaak ma a Saara sẽn ki tɩ yʋʋm a tã la woto, t’a sũurã ra sãam wʋsgo. La a sũurã lebga noog masã.Sɩngre 24:​1-⁠67. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

KOM-​DIBLI a yiibã sẽn be fotã zugã pa wõnd taab ye. Ka sɩda? Yãmb mii b yʋyã bɩ? Sẽn tãood-⁠a tãpã yʋʋr la a Ezayu, tɩ sẽn gãda pesgã yʋʋr yaa a Zakoobe.

A Ezayu ne a Zakoob yaa kinkirsi. Yaa a Izaak ne a Rebeka kamba. A Izaak nonga a Ezayu wʋsgo, bala a yaa tãoos sẽn mi a tʋʋmdã sõma, hal n wat ne nemd wʋsg tɩ zaka rãmb dɩtẽ. A Rebeka yẽ ra nonga a Zakoob n yɩɩda, bala a ra yaa bi-​sõng n pa fir-​fir soab ye.



A Ezayu ne a Zakoob yaab-​raoog a Abrahaam ra ket n vɩɩme. A Zakoob ra nong n kẽnda a nengẽ n kelgd-⁠a t’a gomd a Zeova yelle. A Abrahaam wa n kiime. A sẽn wa n kiidẽ wã t’a tara yʋʋm koabg la pis-​yopoe la a nu, tɩ kinkirsã tar yʋʋm 15.

A Ezayu sẽn wa n tar yʋʋm 40, a kẽe kãadem ne Kanaã kom-​pugli a yiibu. A Izaak ne a Rebeka sũur sãama wʋsgo, bala pʋg-​kãensã ra pa tũud a Zeova ye.

Raar a yembre, a Ezayu sũurã puuga wʋsg ne a yao a Zakoobe. B ba a Izaak ra rat n ninga a bi-​kãsengã barka. Sẽn yaa a Ezayu la kãsmã yĩnga, a ra tẽedame tɩ yẽ n na n paam barkã. La a ra zoe n dɩka a bi-​kãseng pʋɩɩrã n kõ a Zakoob n tek ne rɩɩbo. Sẽn paas me, a Ezayu ne a Zakoob sẽn wa n dogã, Wẽnnaam yeelame tɩ yaa a Zakoob n na n paam barkã. La sɩd yɩɩ woto. Yaa a Zakoob la a Izaak ning barkã.

A Ezayu sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, a sũurã puuga ne a Zakoob hal t’a rat n kʋ-⁠a. A Rebeka sẽn bãng t’a Ezayu rat n kʋʋ a Zakoobã, a yɛɛsame. A yeela a sɩd a Izaak woto: ‘A Zakoob me sã n kẽ kãadem ne Kanaã kom-​pugli wã, mam vɩɩmã ka le tar yõod ye.’

Rẽ poore, a Izaak boola a biig a Zakoob n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Ra kẽ kãadem ne Kanaã bi-​pugl ye. Kẽng Harã, f yaab-​raoog a Betuɛll nengẽ, n tɩ bao a biig a Labã bi-​pugl a ye n kẽ kãadem ne.’

A Zakoob saka a ba wã noore, n yik n na n tog so-​wok n kẽng a buudã neb nengẽ Harã.Sɩngre 25:​5-⁠11, 20-⁠34; 26:⁠34, 35; 27:​1-⁠46; 28:​1-⁠5; Hebre dãmba 12:⁠16, 17. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii rap nins sẽn yas n gomd ne a Zakoobã bɩ? A Zakoob toga sor rasem ka tɛk n wa seg-⁠b bulg noor tɩ b gũud b piisi. A Zakoob sok-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Yãmb yita yɛ?’

B leokame tɩ b yita Harã.

T’a Zakoob sok-⁠b yaa: ‘Yãmb mii a Labã bɩ?’

Tɩ b leok tɩ: ‘N-⁠ye, tõnd mi-⁠a lame. Ad a bi-​pugl a Rasɛll sẽn wat ne a piisã.’ Yãmb nee a Rasɛll fotã zug t’a kẽnd n watẽ bɩ? A Zakoob sẽn yã a Rasɛll sẽn kẽnd n wat ne a ba a Labã piisã, a tɩ laka kugrã sẽn pag bulgã noorã, n wi koomã n kõ piisã tɩ b yũ. Rẽ poore a moka a Rasɛlle, la a togs-⁠a a sẽn yaa ned ninga. A Rasɛll sũurã yɩɩ noog wʋsgo, t’a zoe n kul n tɩ togs a ba a Labã.

A Labã sũur yɩɩ noog wʋsgo, a Zakoob sẽn sig a yirã. A sẽn wa n yeel t’a ratame t’a Rasɛll lebg a pagã me yɩɩ a Labã noogo. La a Labã yeela a Zakoob t’a sã n dat a Rasɛlle, a segd n tʋm n kõo yẽ yʋʋm a yopoe. A Zakoob sakame, bala a ra nonga a Rasɛll wʋsgo. La yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn maan kãadmã daar bɩ?

A Labã pa rɩk a Rasɛll n kõ a Zakoob ye. A rɩka a bi-​pugl kãseng a Lea n kõ-a. Rẽ poore, a Labã yeel-⁠a lame t’a sã n sak n na n tʋm yʋʋm a yopoe n paase, a na n kõ-a-⁠la a Rasɛll me. A Zakoob sakame. Bãmb wakatẽ wã, Wẽnnaam da basame tɩ rapã tõe n kẽ kãadem ne pagb wʋsgo. La masã, Biiblã yetame tɩ rao segd n kẽe kãadem ne pag a ye bala.Sɩngre 29:​1-⁠30. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

data.titulo: A Zakoob zakã neb lebga wʋsgo
data.contenido:
KOM-​DIBLI nins fãa sẽn zĩ ne a Zakoob foto wã zugã yaa yẽ kamba. B yaa bãmb 12. A tara kom-​pugli me. Yãmb mii a Zakoob kambã kẽer yʋy bɩ? Kẽer yʋy la woto:

A Lea roga a Rubɛn, a Simeõ, a Levi la a Zida. A Rasɛll sẽn da pa tõe n dogã yĩnga, a sũurã sãama hal wʋsgo. A rɩka a yemb-​poak a Bila n kõ a Zakoob t’a rog a Dan ne a Naftali. A Lea me rɩka a yemb-​poak a Zilpa n kõ a Zakoob t’a rog a Gaad ne a Azɛɛr. A Lea roga kom-​dibli a yiib n paase. Yaa a Isakaar ne a Zabulõ.

A Rasɛll wa n tõog n doga biiga, n pʋd a yʋʋr t’a Zozɛf. D na n wa goma a Zozɛf yell taoorã, bala a wa n lebga nin-​kãsenga. A Zakoob kom-​dibli 11 yʋy la woto.

A Zakoob ra tara kom-​pugli me, la Biiblã gomda bi-​pugl a ye bal yelle. A yʋʋr la a Dina.

A Zakoob ne a pagbã la a kambã ra bee a rɛɛmb a Labã zakẽ wã. La a Zakoob wa n yikame n na n leb a tẽngẽ wã Kanaã. A tigma a zaka rãmba, a piisã ne a niisã, n na n leb Kanaã sẽn zãr ne Harã wã.

A Zakoob ne a zaka rãmb taa Kanaã. Kaoosg poore, b wa n yikame n na n tɩ zĩnd Kanaã tẽng a to pʋgẽ. A Rasɛll tek n doga bi-​ribl a to sorẽ. A rogmã yɩɩ toogo, hal tɩ tũ ne a yõore. La bũmb da pa tar biigã ye. A Zakoob pʋd-⁠a lame t’a Bẽnzame.

D modg n da yĩm a Zakoob kom-​dibli 12 wã yʋy ye. Bala yaa Israɛll nebã yaab rãmba. Israɛll buud 12 wã sʋka, 10 yʋy n yaa a Zakoob kom-​dibli piigã yʋya, t’a yiib yʋy yaa a Zozɛf kom-​dibli a yiibã yʋya. Kom-​dibli kãensã rogem poor menga, a Izaak vɩɩmdame n kaoose, la a sũurã tog n yɩɩ noogo, a yagensã sẽn da waoogã yĩnga. D ges bũmb ning sẽn paam a yageng a Dina.Sɩngre 29:⁠32-⁠35; 30:​1-⁠26; 35:⁠16-⁠19; 37:⁠35. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii a Dina sẽn debd neb nins nengẽ wã bɩ? Yaa Kanaã kom-​pugli wã nengẽ. Yãmb tagsdame t’a ba a Zakoob sã n bãng rẽ a sũur na n yɩɩ noog bɩ? D tẽeg a Abrahaam ne a Izaak sẽn da tagsd bũmb ning Kanaã pagbã zugu. A Abrahaam da ratame t’a biig a Izaak kẽ kãadem ne Kanaã bi-​pugl sɩda? Ayo. A Izaak ne a Rebeka da ratame tɩ b biig a Zakoob kẽ kãadem ne Kanaã bi-​pugl sɩda? Ayo, bãmb me ra pa rat ye. Bõe yĩnga?

Kanaã nebã ra pʋʋsda ziri wẽnnaam dãmba. B ra pa tõe n yɩ sɩd-​sõma la pʋg-​sõma ye. B leb n da pa tõe n yɩ zo-​sõma ye. Rẽnd a Zakoob sã n da bãng t’a bi-​puglã zo-​rãmb yaa Kanaã kom-​pugli, a sũurã ra na n sãamame.

Sɩd me, yell n paam a Dina. Yãmb nee Kanaã rao ning sẽn get a Dina wã bɩ? A yʋʋr la a Sikɛm. A Dina kẽnga Kanaã kom-​pugli wã nengẽ daar a yembre, t’a Sikɛm modg-⁠a n gãand-⁠a. Woto yaa wẽng wʋsgo, bala yaa rao ne pag sẽn kẽ kãadem bal n tõe n gãand taaba. Yel-​wẽnd ning a Sikɛm sẽn maanã waa ne yɛl a taab n paase.

A Dina kẽem dãmbã sẽn wʋm kibarã, b sũurã puuga hal wʋsgo. A Simeõ ne a Levi sũurã yikame tɩ b rɩk sʋʋs n kẽ tẽngã pʋgẽ tɩ ned ka bãng ye. Bãmb ne b ba-​biis a taabã kʋʋ a Sikɛm la rap a taabã fãa. A Zakoob kom-​dibli wã sẽn maan woto wã yika a sũur wʋsgo.

La yaa bõe n wa ne yel-​kãensa fãa? Yaa a Dina sẽn yõg zood ne neb sẽn pa tũud Wẽnnaam noyã. Tõnd pa rat zo-​rãmb sẽn yaa woto ye. Ka sɩda?Sɩngre 34:​1-⁠31. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

BI-​BƖƖG ning raoã sẽn gãdã nimbãaneg pa tar yãmb sɩda? A yʋʋr la a Zozɛfe. A kẽem dãmbã rɩk-⁠a lame n koos ne rap sẽn debd Ezipti. A Zozɛf sã n ta be, a na n lebga yamba. La bõe yĩng t’a kẽem dãmbã maand woto? Yaa sũ-kiir yĩnga.

B ba a Zakoob nonga a Zozɛf hal wʋsgo. A sẽe kasaab-​neer meng n kõ-a. A kẽem dãmbã sẽn ne tɩ b baabã nonga a Zozɛf wʋsgã yĩnga, sũ-kiir yõk-⁠b lame, tɩ b kisg-⁠a. Bʋʋm a to me n da kɩt tɩ b kis-⁠a.

A Zozɛf gãandame n zãms naoor a yiib fãa t’a kẽem dãmbã wõgemded a taoore. A Zozɛf sẽn togs a kẽem dãmbã, b kisg-⁠a lame n paase.

Raar a yembre, a Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã ra bee weoogẽ n gũud b ba a Zakoob piisã. A Zakoob tʋma a Zozɛf t’a tɩ ges a kẽem dãmbã. A Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã sẽn wa n ne-⁠a t’a watẽ wã, kẽer yeelame tɩ b wa tɩ b kʋ-⁠a. La a Rubɛn sẽn yaa b fãa kẽemã yeelame tɩ b ra kʋ-⁠a ye. B yõk-⁠a lame n tɩ lob bul-​koɛɛng pʋgẽ, n yaool n na n zĩnd n tags n ges b sẽn na n maan-⁠a bũmb ninga. Rẽ poor bilfu, b yãa a Ismaɛll buudã neb sẽn pɩʋʋgde, t’a Zida yeel tɩ b koos a Zozɛf ne Ismaɛll nebã. B sɩd koos-⁠a lame n deeg wanzuri ligd 20. Ad a Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã sɩd ra yaa nin-​wẽnse!

La bõe la a Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã ra na n tɩ yeel b baaba masã? B kodga boɛɛga, n dɩk boɛɛgã zɩɩmã n bol a Zozɛf fu-​neerã tɩ moog sõma. B sẽn ta yirã, b rɩka fuugã n tɩ wilg b ba a Zakoob n yeel woto: ‘Tõnd yãa fu-​kãngã n dɩke. Bɩ y reeg n ges ka a Zozɛf fuugã la woto?’

A Zakoob sẽn ges fuugã, a bãngame tɩ yaa a Zozɛf rẽndã. A kelmame n yeel tɩ ‘we-​rũng n kʋ a Zozɛfe.’ Yaa woto la a Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã da rat tɩ b ba wã tagse. B ba wã sũur sãamã wʋsg t’a yãb rasem ka tɛka. La a Zozɛf ra pa ki ye. D ges bũmb ning sẽn paam-⁠a Ezipti.Sɩngre 37:​1-⁠35. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

B SẼN wa n tall a Zozɛf n kẽng Eziptã t’a tara yʋʋm 17 bala. Yaa rao a ye sẽn boond t’a Potifaar n da-⁠a t’a lebg a yamba. A Potifaar ra yaa Ezipt naab a Faraõ sodaasã taoor soab a ye.

A Zozɛf ra tʋmda sõma n kõt a zu-​soab a Potifaare. Rẽ n so t’a Zozɛf sẽn wa n lebg kãsengã, a Potifaar kɩtame t’a get a zakã fãa yelle. La bõe yĩng t’a Zozɛf be bãens roogẽ? Yaa a Potifaar pagã n maane.

A Zozɛf bɩɩme n lebg ra-​sãnga, t’a Potifaar pagã rat t’a Zozɛf gãand-⁠a. La a Zozɛf pa sak ye, bala a miime tɩ yaa wẽnga. A Potifaar pagã sũur puugame. A sɩdã sẽn yi tʋʋmã n wa wã, a yaga ziri t’a Zozɛf baoome n na n gãand yẽ. A Potifaar ra tẽedame t’a pagã togsda sɩda. A sũurã puuga wʋsg ne a Zozɛf t’a kɩt tɩ b tɩ pag-⁠a bãens roogẽ.

Ned ning sẽn gũud bãensã roogã wa n mikame t’a Zozɛf yaa nin-​sõngo, t’a yeel-⁠a t’a ges neb a taabã sẽn be bãensã roogẽ wã fãa yelle. Raar a yembre, ned ning sẽn get a Faraõ rɩɩbã yellã, la ned ning sẽn yaa a rã-kɩtã maaname t’a Faraõ sũurã puugi, t’a kɩt tɩ b kẽes-⁠b bãens roogẽ. Yʋng a yembre, b yiibã fãa gãandame n zãmse, la b ra pa mi b zãmsdã võor ye. La vẽkembeoogã, a Zozɛf yeel-⁠b lame tɩ b togs yẽ b sẽn zãms bũmb ningã. B sẽn togs-⁠a wã, Wẽnnaam sõnga a Zozɛf t’a wilg-⁠b b zãmsdã võore.

A Zozɛf yeela rã-kɩtã woto: ‘Ra-​tãta, b na n yiis-⁠a foo bãensã roogẽ, tɩ fo lebg a Faraõ rã-kɩt yɛsa. La fo sã n wa yi, bɩ f gom mam yell ne a Faraõ t’a yiis-⁠m bãensã roogẽ.’ La a Zozɛf yeela ned ning sẽn geta rɩɩbã yell yaa: ‘Ra-​tãta, a Faraõ na n kɩtame tɩ b fiuug fo zugã.’

Ra-​tãt-⁠n-​daarã sẽn sɩd ta, a Faraõ kɩtame tɩ b fiuug sẽn geta rɩɩbã yellã zugu, la a kɩt tɩ b yiis rã-kɩtã bãensã roogẽ. La rã-kɩtã sẽn lebs n sɩng a tʋʋmdã a Faraõ nengẽ wã, a yĩma a Zozɛf yell fasɩ! A pa gom a Zozɛf yell ne a Faraõ ye. A Zozɛf kell n paa bãensã roogẽ.Sɩngre 39:​1-⁠23; 40:​1-⁠23. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YƲƲM a yiib loogr poore, a Zozɛf ra keta bãensã roogẽ. Rã-​kɩtã ra yĩma a yelle. La yʋng a yembre, a Faraõ gãand n zãmsa zãmsd a yiibu, la a sẽn wa n nekã, a ra rat n bãnga a zãmsdã võore. Yãmb pa ne-⁠a fotã zug t’a gãe sɩda? Vẽkembeoogã, a Faraõ boola a bag-​bʋgdbã n togs a sẽn gãand n zãms n yã bũmb ningã. La b baa a ye pa tõog n togs a zãmsdã võor ye.

Masã la rã-kɩtã yaool n tẽeg a Zozɛf yelle. A yeela a Faraõ tɩ yẽ sẽn wa n be bãensã roogẽ wã, rao n da be be n tar tõog n tõe n togs zãmsd võore. A Faraõ kɩtame tɩ b tɩ yiis a Zozɛf bãensã roogẽ tao-​tao t’a wa. A Faraõ yeela a Zozɛf woto: ‘Mam deng n zãms n yãa nag-​nobds a yopoe, la nag-​wag a yopoe. Nag-​wagã wãba nag-​nobdsã.’

‘Mam le zãms n yãa kaaf a ye sẽn wom ka-​zut a yopoe sẽn bɩ sõma n yaa neere, la m yã ka-⁠zu-​faad a yopoe me. La ka-⁠zu-​faad a yopoe wã rɩɩ ka-⁠zu-​sõma a yopoe wã.’ A Zozɛf yeela a Faraõ yaa: ‘Zãmsd a yiibã fãa võor yaa a yembre. Nag-​nobds a yopoe wã la ka-​zut a yopoe sẽn bɩ sõma wã yaa yʋʋm a yopoe. Nag-​wag a yopoe wã la ka-⁠zu-​faad a yopoe wã me yaa yʋʋm a yopoe. Yʋʋm a yopoe n wat tɩ rɩɩb wʋsg na n zĩnd Ezipti. La rẽ poore, yʋʋm a yopoe n wat tɩ kom na n zĩndi.’

Rẽ n so t’a Zozɛf yeel a Faraõ yaa: ‘Bɩ y bao rao sẽn tar bãngr la yam, n kɩt t’a tigs rɩɩbã yʋʋm a yopoe nins sẽn na n yɩ tɩgr sasa wã. Woto, yʋʋm a yopoe komã sã n wa, nebã pa na n ki kom ye.’

A Zozɛf goamã yɩɩ a Faraõ noogo, t’a kell n yãk-⁠a t’a na n tigs rɩɩbã n bĩngi. Masã, a Zozɛf lebga nin-​kãseng Ezipti. A Faraõ sẽn yãk a toogo, yẽ n yɩɩd neb a taabã fãa.

Yʋʋm a nii loogr poore, komã sẽn wa n kẽ tẽngã, a Zozɛf wa n zĩi raar a ye n ne rap sẽn wate. Yãmb mii sẽn yaa neb nins bɩ? Yaa a Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã. B ba a Zakoob tʋm-⁠b lame tɩ b wa bao rɩɩb Ezipti, bala rɩɩb ra pa le be Kanaã ye. A Zozɛf bãnga a kẽem dãmbã, la bãmb ka bãng-⁠a ye. Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ b pa bãng-⁠a wã bɩ? Yaa a Zozɛf sẽn lebg kãsmã yĩnga. Sẽn paas me, a ra yeelga naam futu.

Tõnd ra zoe n yãame t’a Zozɛf sẽn da wa n yaa biigã, a ra zãmsame n yã a kẽem dãmbã tɩ b wõgemd a taoore. Masã, a sẽn yã a kẽem dãmbã, a tẽega rẽ yelle. A Zozɛf bãngame tɩ yaa Wẽnnaam n tʋm yẽ Ezipti, la pa zaalem yĩng ye. La yãmb tagsdame t’a Zozɛf na n maana bõe masã? Bɩ d ges sẽn pʋgdã.Sɩngre 41:​1-⁠57; 42:​1-⁠8; 50:⁠20. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZOZƐF ratame n bãng a kẽem dãmbã sã n ket n yaa nin-​wẽnse, bɩ b sã n toeemame. A yeel-⁠b-⁠la woto: ‘Yãmb waame n na n soos n ges tõnd tẽnga zĩis nins sẽn ka pãngã.’

La b leokame yaa: ‘Ayo, tõnd ka wa n na n ges tẽngã ye. Tõnd pa nin-​wẽns ye. Tõnd fãa yaa rao a ye kamba. Tõnd ba wã roga tõnd piig la a yiibu. D yao-​zʋʋgã paa ne tõnd ba wã yiri, la a ye n ka le be.’

La a Zozɛf maana wa a pa tẽed a kẽem dãmbã goam ye. A kɩtame tɩ b kẽes a kẽem a Simeõ bãens roogo, la a bas a taabã tɩ b tall rɩɩbã n looge. La a yeel-⁠b-⁠la woto: ‘Y sã n wa lebg n watẽ bɩ y zã y yao-​zʋʋgã n wa.’

A Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã sẽn lebg n kul Kanaã wã, b togsa b ba a Zakoob yɛlã fãa. A Zakoob sũurã sãamame t’a yeel woto: ‘A Zozɛf kae ye, a Simeõ me kae ye. Mam biig a Bẽnzame ka na n tũ yãmb n kẽng be ye.’ La b rɩɩbã sẽn wa n kolgd saabã, a Zakoob kong n basame t’a Bẽnzame na n tũ a kẽem dãmbã n kẽng Ezipti, tɩ b paam dɩɩbo.

Raar a yembre, a Zozɛf wa n nee a ba-​biisã sẽn wate. A sẽn yã a yao a Bẽnzame wã, a sũurã yɩɩ noog wʋsgo. La b ned baa a ye ra pa mi tɩ nin-​kãsengã yaa a Zozɛf ye. A Zozɛf maana bũmb n na n ges a kẽem dãmbã sã n toeema zʋgo.

A kɩtame t’a sõgen dãmbã pids a ba-​biisã yond ne rɩɩbo. A leb n kɩtame tɩ b ning a wanzuri wũmblã a Bẽnzame yolgã pʋgẽ n naag rɩɩbã, tɩ b baa a ye ka bãng ye. B sẽn pids b yondã n sa tɩ b loog n zãag bilfu, a Zozɛf tʋma a sõgen dãmbã tɩ b babs-⁠ba. Sõgen dãmbã sẽn ta b nengẽ wã, b yeel-⁠b-⁠la woto: ‘Bõe yĩng tɩ yãmb zuk tõnd zu-​soabã wanzuri wũmblã?’

La a Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã yeela woto: ‘Tõnd pa zuk bũmb ye. Yãmb sã n vaees n yã-a tõnd nin-⁠yend yolgẽ fãa, bɩ y kʋ a soaba.’

Sõgen dãmbã vaeesa yondã fãa n tɩ yã wũmblã a Bẽnzame yolgã pʋgẽ. Sõgen dãmbã yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Bɩ neb a taabã looge, tɩ tõnd na n talla a Bẽnzame n lebe.’ A Zozɛf kẽem dãmbã na n maana wãn masã?

B fãa tũu a Bẽnzame n leb a Zozɛf nengẽ. B sẽn ta wã, a Zozɛf yeel-⁠b lame t’a Bẽnzame na n paame n lebg yẽ yamba, la tɩ bãmb tõe n kulame.

La a Zida yeela woto: ‘Mam sã n lebg n kul n pa tall biigã, mam ba wã na n kiime, bala a nong-⁠a-⁠la wʋsgo. Yaa rẽ yĩng la mam kot yãmb masã tɩ y bas tɩ mam pa ka n yɩ yãmb yamba, la y bas tɩ biigã tũ a kẽem dãmbã n kuli.’

A Zozɛf bãngame masã t’a kẽem dãmbã toeema zʋgo. B lebga nin-​sõma. D ges a Zozɛf sẽn na n maan bũmb ning masã.Sɩngre 42:​9-⁠38; 43:​1-⁠34; 44:​1-⁠34. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZOZƐF ra pa le tõe n yõk a meng ye. A mak n kong n yeela a sõgen dãmbã fãa tɩ b yi. A sõgen dãmbã sẽn yi n bas yẽ ne a ba-​biisã, a sɩnga yãbre. A ba-​biisã yɛɛsame, bala b pa mi bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a yãbdã ye. A Zozɛf wa n baas n yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Yaa maam la a Zozɛfe. M ba wã ket n vɩɩme bɩ?’

La a ba-​biisã ra pa tõe n leok ye. B yɛɛsa wʋsgo. La a Zozɛf yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Wa-⁠y n kolg-⁠y ka.’ La b sẽn kolgã, a yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Mam yaa yãmb yao a Zozɛf yãmb sẽn koos tɩ b tall n wa Ezipt tẽngã.’

‘La masã, ra ning-⁠y y meng taale, yãmb sẽn koos maam tɩ b tall maam n wa ka wã yĩng ye. Tɩ bõe, yaa Wẽnnaam n tʋm maam Ezipti, tɩ m wa fãag nebã vɩɩm. A Faraõ kɩtame tɩ mam lebg Ezipt soolmã fãa taoor soaba. Masã, bɩ y leb m ba wã nengẽ tao-​tao n tɩ togs-⁠a mam sẽn yeel yãmb bũmb ningã fãa, la y yeel-⁠a t’a wa zĩnd Ezipt ka.’

Rẽ poore, a Zozɛf mobga a ba-​biisã fãa sõma n mok-⁠ba. A Faraõ sẽn wʋm t’a Zozɛf ba-​biisã waame wã, a yeela a Zozɛf yaa: ‘Yeel bãmb tɩ b rɩk sarɛt rãmb n tɩ rɩk b kom-​bõonegã ne b pagbã, la b tall b ba wã n wa. Mam na n baoa zĩ-sõng Ezipt tẽngã pʋgẽ n kõ-ba.’

RAP nins sẽn yasã modgda nebã tɩ b tʋmdẽ. Yãmb pa ne rao a yembrã sẽn pãbd tʋm-​tʋmd a ye ne sãbsg sɩda? Tʋm-​tʋmdbã yaa Israɛll nebã. Yaa a Zakoob yagense. Neb nins sẽn modgd-⁠b tɩ b tʋmdẽ wã yaa Ezipt neba. Israɛll nebã lebga Ezipt nebã yembse. La maana wãn tɩ wa lebg woto?

YÃMB nee bi-​pɛɛlg ning sẽn gãd pagã nugã n yãbdã bɩ? Yaa a Moiizi. Yãmb mii pʋg-⁠ne-​kãngã sẽn yaa ned ning bɩ? Yaa Ezipt naab a Faraõ bi-​pugla.

YÃMB nee rapã sẽn digd a Moiiz t’a zoet n yit Eziptã bɩ? Bõe yĩng tɩ b rat n kʋ a Moiizi? Bɩ d naag taab n gese.

DAAR a yembre, a Moiiz talla a piisã n kẽng hal Horɛb tãngẽ wã tɩ b na n tɩ wãb yamdo. A sẽn ta tãngã sɛɛga, a yãa tuug sẽn wit bugum, n yaool n pa rɩtẽ ye.

T’a Moiiz yeel yaa: ‘La mam sã n tɩ yeel-⁠b tɩ foo n tʋm maam tɩ b ka tẽeda?’

Wẽnnaam lebg n soka a Moiiz yaa: ‘Bõe la fo sẽn zãadã?’

T’a Moiiz leok tɩ yaa rasaare.

Tɩ Wẽnnaam yeel-⁠a t’a lob rasaarã tẽnga. A Moiiz loba rasaarã tẽnga, tɩ lebg waafo. A Zeova wilga a Moiiz yel-​solemd a to. A yeel-⁠a lame t’a sui a nugã a fuugã pʋgẽ. A Moiiz sẽn sui a nugã a fuugã pʋgẽ n lebg n yiisã, lebga wa wãood n tar-⁠a. A Zeova leb n kõo a Moiiz tõogo, t’a na n tɩ tõog n maan yel-​solemd a to n paase. A MOIIZ sẽn ta Eziptã, a togsa a kẽem a Aarõ Wẽnnaam sẽn maan yel-​soalem nins fãa n wilg-⁠a wã. A Moiiz ne a Aarõ maana yel-​soalmã n wilg Israɛll nebã, tɩ b fãa tẽ tɩ yaa a Zeova n sɩd tʋm-⁠ba.

A Moiiz ne a Aarõ kẽnga a Faraõ nengẽ n tɩ yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Israɛll Wẽnnaam a Zeova yeelame tɩ f bas a nebã tɩ b kẽng weoogẽ wã n tɩ maan kibs n waoog-⁠a rasem a tãabo.’ La a Faraõ leokame yaa: ‘Mam ka mi a Zeova ye. M ka na n bas Israɛll nebã tɩ b loog ye.’

A Faraõ sũurã puugame, bala Israɛll nebã da rat n basa b tʋʋmã n tɩ waoog a Zeova. A modg-⁠b lame tɩ b tʋm wʋsg n paase. Israɛll nebã yeelame tɩ yaa a Moiiz n kɩt tɩ b namsd-⁠b woto. Rẽ sãama a Moiiz sũurã. La a Zeova yeela a Moiiz t’a ra sãam a sũur t’a na n modga a Faraõ t’a bas a nebã tɩ b looge. A Moiiz ne a Aarõ kẽnga a Faraõ nengẽ yɛsa. La so-​kãnga, b maana yel-​solemde. A Aarõ loba a rasaarã tẽng tɩ lebg waafo. A Faraõ bag-​bʋgdbã me loba b rasabã tẽng tɩ lebg wiisi. La a Aarõ waafã vela bag-​bʋgdbã wiisã. Baasg zãnga, a Faraõ ka bas Israɛll nebã tɩ b loog ye.

Masã, a Zeova na n wilga a Faraõ yam. Yãmb mii a sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ? A kɩtame tɩ yel-​beed 10 paam Ezipt nebã.

Yel-​beed sã n wa fãa, a Faraõ boonda a Moiiz n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Fo sã n kɩt tɩ yel-​beedã looge, m na n basa Israɛll nebã tɩ b looge.’ La yel-​beedã sã n loog fãa, a Faraõ toeemda yam. A pa basd Israɛll nebã tɩ b loog ye. La yel-​beed 10 soabã poore, a Faraõ basa Israɛll nebã tɩ b na n looge.

Yãmb mii yel-​beed 10 fãa sẽn yaa b rãmb bɩ? Lak-⁠y seb-​neng ning sẽn pʋgdã tɩ y na bãnge.Yikri 4:⁠27-⁠31; 5:​1-⁠23; 6:​1-⁠13, 26-⁠30; 7:​1-⁠13. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y foto rãmbã. Yaa yel-​beed piig nins a Zeova sẽn kɩt tɩ paam Ezipt nebã la woto. Pipi fotã zugu, a Aarõ rɩka a rasaarã n wẽ Nill kʋɩlgã koomã tɩ lebg zɩɩm. Zĩmã kiime n põog tɩ koomã lebg yũugu. A Zeova kɩtame me tɩ loms yi Nill kʋɩlgã pʋgẽ n kẽ tẽngã. Lomsã ra bee zĩig fãa. B ra bee Ezipt nebã wʋmsẽ wã, b laasẽ wã la b gãasã zutu. Lomsã kiime tɩ Ezipt nebã wʋk-⁠b wʋsg n zame. B põogame tɩ tẽngã fãa lebg yũugu.

A Aarõ leb n dɩka a rasaarã n wẽ tẽngã tɩ tomã lebg rũmpigli n wãbd Ezipt tẽngã neb fãa. Woto n yɩ yel-​beed a tãab-⁠n-​soabã. Yel-​beed a tãabã fãa paama Ezipt nebã ne Israɛll nebã. La yel-​beed a taabã paama Ezipt nebã bala. Yel-​beed a naas-⁠n-​soabã yɩɩ nag-​zõos wʋsg n kẽ Ezipt nebã fãa rot pʋsẽ. Nu soabã paama rũmsã. Ezipt nebã niisi, b bõense, b piis la bʋʋs wʋsg n ki.

Rẽ poore, a Moiiz ne a Aarõ wʋka tom-​pɛglem n fãeeg tɩ ninsaalbã ne rũmsã fãa yĩns lebg nod-​tãoodense. Yaa yel-​beed a yoob-⁠n-​soabã la rẽ.

Yopoe soabã, a Moiiz tẽega a nugã yĩngr t’a Zeova kɩt tɩ saagã tãsdẽ la a yãgda, tɩ sapɩlem rʋʋgdẽ. B ra nan zɩ n yã sapɩlem a woto buud Ezipt soolmã pʋgẽ ye. Nii soabã yɩɩ sʋy wʋsg sẽn wa n dɩ sapɩlmã sẽn pa sãam bũmb ningã. Sʋy ra nan zɩ n yɩ wʋsg woto ye. A buud me pa le zĩnd ye.

Yel-​beed a wɛ soabã yɩɩ lika. Ezipt nebã zĩnda lik bida pʋgẽ rasem a tãabo, tɩ Israɛll nebã sẽn da beẽ wã yaool n da tar vẽenem.

Sẽn na n baase, Wẽnnaam yeela a nin-​buiidã tɩ b kodg bull bɩ pe-​bil n yãk a zɩɩmã n bol b rig-​noyã. Rẽ poore, Wẽnnaam kɩtame t’a malɛk a ye pɩʋʋg Ezipt tẽngã pʋgẽ. Malɛkã sã n pɩʋʋg n yã zɩɩm sẽn taag rig-​noore, a pa kʋʋd ro-​kãng ned ye. La zɩɩmã sẽn pa taag rig-​noor ning fãa, a kʋʋda nebã kom-​dẽemsã la rũng fãa pipi biig sẽn be zag-​kãng pʋgẽ wã. Yaa yel-​beed piig soabã la rẽ.

GES-⁠Y bũmb ning sẽn maand masã! Ned ning sẽn dɩk a rasaarã n tees Mog-​miuugã yaa a Moiizi. Neb nins sẽn be ne-⁠a wã yaa Israɛll nebã. La yaa a Faraõ ne a sodaasã fãa la sẽn pa koomã pʋgẽ tɩ koomã rat n dɩ-​bã. D ges sẽn yɩ to-⁠to.

Wa d sẽn zoe n yã wã, yel-​beed piigã poore, a Faraõ basa Israɛll nebã tɩ b looge. Yaa Israɛll rap sẽn ta tus kobs-​yoob n paas pagb la kamb n tũ taab n yi Eziptã. Buud a taab neb wʋsg me sẽn tẽed a Zeova n tũ Israɛll nebã. B fãa zãa b piisã, b bʋʋsã, b niisã la b bõensã n looge.

Nand tɩ Israɛll nebã looge, b kosa Ezipt nebã futu, la nag-​teed sẽn maan ne wanzuri la sãnem. Yel-​beed piig soabã yɛɛsa Ezipt nebã wʋsg tɩ b kõ Israɛll nebã b sẽn da ratã fãa.

Rasem a wãn poore, Israɛll nebã taa Mog-​miuugẽ wã. B yalsa be n na n vʋʋse. La a Faraõ ne a nebã yõdg n maana b bãngẽ, b sẽn bas Israɛll nebã tɩ b loogã. B yeelame yaa: ‘Ges-⁠y tõnd sẽn bas d yembsã tɩ b looge!’

A Faraõ le toeema yam, n kɩt t’a sodaasã na n bob zab-​teed n babs Israɛll nebã. Yaa saar dãmb sẽn zoet sõma bãmb kobs-​yoobe, n paas saar dãmb a taab la b zomb n na n babs Israɛll nebã.

Israɛll nebã sẽn wẽneg n yã t’a Faraõ ne a sodaasã watẽ wã, rabeem yõk-⁠b-⁠la wʋsgo. B ra yasa Mog-​miuugã taoor tɩ Ezipt nebã yaool n da wat b poorẽ wã. B pa tar zĩig n na n kẽng ye. La a Zeova ninga sawadg Israɛll nebã ne Ezipt nebã sʋka, tɩ Ezipt nebã pa tõe n le yã Israɛll nebã n zab ne-⁠b ye.

A Zeova yeela a Moiiz t’a rɩk a rasaarã n tees Mog-​miuugã. A Moiiz sẽn tees a rasaarã, a Zeova kɩtame tɩ seb-​kẽeng fugi, tɩ koomã welg zĩis a yiibu, n leb goabg la rɩtg n bas sʋkã vɩʋʋgo.
